teams.detail: Off day today, 2nd in the AL West, one game behind Texas (49-47) and holding a wild-card spot. Open a four-game series at home against the Giants starting Thursday, July 16, with the July 18 game on FOX.

Wrap up 2026 Summer League tonight against Phoenix (tipped 6 PM ET, ESPNU) sitting 1-2 after a win over Cleveland (103-94) sandwiched between losses to Philadelphia (93-101) and New York (75-86). Guard Ebuka Okorie has led the way, including a 7-steal, 14-point outing versus the Knicks. Detroit also finalized a six-team trade this month, sending out Isaiah Stewart and Caris LeVert while adding John Collins, Taurean Prince and Gary Harris.

The Paul Allen Estate's sale of the franchise to a Khosla family-led group for an NFL-record $9.6 billion still awaits ratification from at least 24 of the other 31 owners. OLB Derick Hall signed a three-year extension today, and the entire 2026 draft class is now under contract after Jadarian Price's deal. Training camp opens July 25 in Renton; Football Fest is Aug. 8 at Lumen Field.

Coach Jedd Fisch's staff landed a 4-star cornerback commitment, the class's highest-rated pledge, while still targeting a second corner and O-line help. RB Jordan Washington is aiming for a late-July return from a spring injury ahead of fall camp. Season opens Sept. 5 vs. Washington State (Apple Cup) at Husky Stadium.

Danny Sprinkle is rebuilding through the transfer portal and overseas recruiting after losing Zoom Diallo to the portal, with international forward Nikola Dzepina among the new additions. F Hannes Steinbach, taken 14th overall by Charlotte in the 2026 NBA Draft, remains the program's top recent NBA export.

headlines.headline: LeBron tells Lakers he's leaving; Cavs emerge as frontrunner
headlines.detail: LeBron James informed the Lakers he plans to play his 24th season elsewhere, ending an eight-year run in L.A.; agent Rich Paul has fielded interest from 27 teams. A homecoming to Cleveland has picked up momentum, though Golden State, Miami, Denver and Minnesota remain in the mix.

headlines.headline: Franchise tag deadline passes quietly; Pickens the lone holdout
headlines.detail: Wednesday's deadline for tagged players to sign multiyear deals came and went with little drama: Daniel Jones signed a two-year, $88 million contract, Breece Hall a three-year, $43.5 million deal with the Jets, and Kyle Pitts a three-year, $54 million extension in Atlanta. George Pickens remains the only tagged player still unsigned.

headlines.headline: ACC, Mountain West and Sun Belt open media days; Cignetti passes Smart in coaches poll
headlines.detail: The ACC's three-day Football Kickoff opened in Charlotte with Florida State, Miami, NC State, Stanford and Virginia represented, while Mountain West and Sun Belt media days also began Wednesday. Indiana's Curt Cignetti unseated Georgia's Kirby Smart atop the USA Today coaches poll released today.

headlines.headline: Texas' Marcus Spears Jr. reclassification headlines a record portal summer
headlines.detail: No. 1-ranked 2027 prospect Marcus Spears Jr. reclassified up and committed to Texas, vaulting the Longhorns into a top-five 2026 class. More than 2,700 players have moved through the transfer portal since Michigan's title-game win over UConn four weeks ago.
